The government didn’t “shut down” because Republicans gutted health care or child nutrition ~ it shut down because Democrats tried to cram another trillion-dollar bailout for illegal aliens into a spending bill and expected taxpayers to smile while footing the tab.

This isn’t about health care. It’s about border care ~ hotels, phones, food, and medical coverage for people who jumped the fence while veterans sleep on concrete and working families drown in rent hikes. Republicans finally said enough ~ and pulled the plug on a government that refuses to put Americans first.

So no, this isn’t cruelty. It’s clarity. The American taxpayer is not an open bar tab for the world.

“Republicans gutted health care”? The Affordable Care Act still exists. Medicare and Medicaid budgets are fatter than ever. The only thing Republicans “gutted” was the idea that Washington can print money forever and call it compassion.

“Child nutrition gutted”? Total fiction. WIC and school-meal programs were protected and funded ~ what got blocked was the absurd push to fold illegal-alien feeding programs into “child nutrition.” The tantrum from the Left came when they realized the free-ride menu had been closed to non-citizens.

“Debt from tax breaks for billionaires”? Stop it. The real debt driver is government gluttony: runaway welfare, interest payments approaching a trillion dollars a year, and agencies that treat your paycheck like Monopoly money. The “billionaires” narrative is just the shiny distraction that hides who’s actually being robbed ~ you.

Meanwhile, American seniors, vets, and parents can’t get help while the administration dumps billions into border hotels, translators, healthcare, transport, and legal aid for people who don’t belong here.

That’s not compassion. That’s betrayal.

If you care about fairness, you secure the border first. You protect your citizens first. You fix your economy first. You don’t bankrupt your nation to virtue-signal for the U.N.

So let’s call it what it is:
The government didn’t shut down because Republicans hate health care.
It shut down because Democrats demanded Americans fund the health care of illegal aliens.

Republicans refused.
Finally.

And that’s not cruelty ~ that’s the first act of sanity Washington’s seen in years.
